gap.comment: cta.scss:15 — `> div { ... gap: 1rem; }` (the direct child wrapper around .cta__title/.cta__content) AND cta.scss:18 — `.cta__container { margin-block-end: 1rem; }`. Same literal value in both places; one token per the one-token-per-value convention (headline/highlight/background's reuse across 3 SCSS locations is the precedent, tokens/components/headline.json). Both are raw `1rem` literals (not a named Sass var) local to cta.scss — unlike $xlg below, nothing suggests they are shared cross-component vocabulary, so this is modeled as CTA's own owned rhythm value rather than left raw.
